column3: The clause about apostolic weight is moved from verse 7 in the Greek; “demand it” specifies the weight as claiming praise.
BSB’s “gentle” follows the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “infants” (νήπιοι). The opening clause about apostolic weight belongs to verse 6 in the BSB.
“We treated” supplies a verb in the suspended clause.
BSB’s “their own” with prophets matches the Textus Receptus (ἰδίους); the critical text has simply “the prophets.”
“How” makes the speech’s content explicit; “of God” with wrath is not expressed.
Striving to see them is rendered as intensified desire.
Once and twice is rendered as “again and again.”
